name: JFrog MCP Server
description: Connects AI coding assistants to the JFrog Platform to manage projects and Artifactory repositories and to check package vulnerability and curation status.

skills.name: Manage Projects And Repositories
skills.description: Creates and views JFrog projects, Artifactory repositories, roles, users, and groups.

skills.name: Check Package Vulnerabilities
skills.description: Looks up package versions and their vulnerability status, and returns Xray security summaries and violations for artifacts.

skills.name: Review Curation Compliance
skills.description: Checks remote packages against curation policies, queries audit events, and creates or decides waiver requests.

skills.name: Inspect Builds
skills.description: Lists Artifactory builds and build runs and returns detailed build information.
